verdict.rationale: Neon has some event-driven pieces. Managed Better Auth webhooks let you handle authentication events with custom server logic. The MCP tool surface lists Neon Functions "triggers", though without any detail. neon.ts adds declarative branch policies such as TTL auto-expiry. Nothing in the evidence shows a general rules engine for defining event→action automations across the platform. missing for 10: a documented rules/automation engine, details on what events Function triggers support, database-change triggers or webhooks beyond auth, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
